prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE transparent combat transition sprite sheet, exactly 4 columns and 4 rows, sixteen separate complete characters with generous transparent gutters. Image 1 is the exact character identity, art style, head proportions and sword reference; do not edit that existing sheet, make a NEW matching sheet.
Character: same short orange tabby cat adventurer, amber eyes, cream muzzle and shirt, red scarf, brown vest/backpack, olive trousers and brown boots, same short steel sword with brass crossguard. Same physical RIGHT paw handles the weapon throughout, same belt sheath, never swap hands. Identical head size and clothing in every drawing, full body, planted boot baseline. Real shoulder, elbow, paw, tail and scarf action. Preserve the original compact animal proportions.
Rows: row 1 faces front three-quarter southeast; row 2 front three-quarter southwest; row 3 rear three-quarter northeast; row 4 rear three-quarter northwest. Each row has the same camera angle as its corresponding reference row.
Columns:
1. DRAWING: relaxed planted stance, right paw reaches down and begins pulling the sword from its belt sheath, blade partly exposed angled down beside the hip, left paw balances near chest. A genuine draw motion, not an overhead attack.
2. EARLY SLASH: intermediate between the reference wind-up and strike: right elbow begins extending across the torso, blade forward on a descending diagonal about halfway through the slash; knees flex slightly and shoulders follow. Not an idle pose.
3. LATE SLASH: intermediate strike-to-follow-through: sword has passed forward, right arm follows through with blade low outside body, torso turns naturally, weight on leading boot. Distinct from column 2.
4. SHEATHING: relaxed planted stance again, right paw guides the blade back into the SAME belt sheath, most of blade already inserted, hilt next to hip, left paw steadies belt. The sword must not be raised or held forward.
Same body and head scale across all sixteen cells. Draw each complete cat, weapon, tail and ears inside its own cell with clear empty margins. Transparent background, no ground, no shadows, no grid lines, no labels, no text, no motion trails. Painterly anime JRPG sprite quality, consistent lighting and anatomy.
usage: Original unmodified PNG. Four drawing/sheathing/in-between poses per direction are interleaved with the earlier attack poses. Registration is read-only; gameplay hit times and art share combat_timing.gd.
